statement: Under (1.1)–(1.2), there is CA = CA(q, J, ∆) such that every A ⊆ Λ satisfies SΩ(A) ≤ CA|∂ΛA|, ∂ΛA = {{x, y} ∈ E(Λ) : x ∈ A, y / ∈ A}. The same constant works for every L and every Hamiltonian in the class.
